props.sub: S.A.S. Services arranges hassle-free Hajj, Umrah and Ziyarat packages tailored to your needs — visa, flights, transport, hotels and qualified religious guides, with 24/7 on-ground assistance.

props.label: About Us
props.heading: A trusted partner for your pilgrimage
props.body:
S.A.S. Services Haj Umrah Ziyarat Tours is a trusted partner for creating spiritually uplifting pilgrimages. We specialise in organising hassle-free Hajj, Umrah and Ziyarat packages tailored to your needs.

Your comfort is our priority. We manage all logistics seamlessly, including visa processing, flight bookings and comfortable ground transportation, so nothing is left for you to work out on arrival.

Experienced and qualified religious guides accompany groups to assist with proper execution of the rites. We provide customised tour plans, with budget-friendly and luxury options to suit every pilgrim.

Hygienic meal arrangements and 24/7 on-ground assistance ensure complete peace of mind throughout your trip. We also organise peaceful, enriching Ziyarat tours to historical and significant Islamic sites in Saudi Arabia.

props.blurb: S.A.S. Services Haj Umrah Ziyarat Tours — hassle-free Hajj, Umrah and Ziyarat packages from Nagpur, with visa processing, flights, transport, hotels and qualified religious guides.
props.termsBody: Package prices, departure dates and inclusions are confirmed in writing at the time of booking and are subject to airline fares, hotel availability and prevailing exchange rates. Visa issuance is decided solely by the authorities of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (and, for Ziyarat itineraries, by the relevant authorities of the destination country); we assist with the application and documentation but cannot guarantee approval, and government fees are non-refundable once submitted. Pilgrims are responsible for holding a valid passport with sufficient validity, for meeting all health and vaccination requirements in force at the time of travel, and for complying with the regulations of the destination country. Cancellation and refund terms are set out in your booking confirmation. Itineraries may change where required by the authorities, by the airline, or for the safety of the group. items.q: What is included in a package?
items.a: Usually visa processing, flights, hotel accommodation, ground transport, hygienic meal arrangements and a qualified religious guide with the group. The exact inclusions depend on whether you take a budget or a premium plan, and are confirmed in writing before booking.

Yes. We build tour plans around the group — the number of days, the standard of hotel and whether you want Ziyarat added. Tell us your budget honestly and we will tell you what is realistic within it.

items.q: Is a guide with us throughout?
items.a: Experienced and qualified religious guides accompany groups to assist with proper execution of the rites, and 24/7 on-ground assistance is available for anything else during the trip.
Yes, we assist with passport applications and renewals. Start this early — a passport delay is the most common reason a booked pilgrim cannot travel.

No. Visa issuance is decided by the authorities of the destination country. We prepare and submit the application properly and keep you informed, but nobody can guarantee approval, and you should be wary of an agent who claims they can.
Hygienic meal arrangements are made through the stay. If anyone in the group has a dietary requirement or a medical restriction, tell us at booking so it is planned for rather than improvised.

Call or WhatsApp 72764 21027, or visit the office at Darbar Complex, Taj Bagh, between 10 AM and 6 PM Monday to Saturday. Tell us your preferred month and group size and we will send a written quotation.
